snippet.title: How Deep - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A co-op extraction mining game for 1-4 players. Ride the elevator down into procedurally generated caverns, dig up treasure, fight off what lurks in the dark, then decide whether to head back to the surface or risk going deeper.
